settings.title: Settings

finalPrice.title: Who enters the final price?
finalPrice.description: Choose who enters the final price of an order when the job is done. The rule applies to all handymen of the company.

WORKER.title: The handyman enters it
WORKER.description: When the job is done the handyman types the final price on the phone — the manager gets a notification.

MANAGER.title: The manager enters it
MANAGER.description: The handyman finishes the job, the manager enters and confirms the price in the app or the panel. The handyman does not see the price step.

finalPrice.how: Whichever mode you choose, an order is not closed without a price, and the amount is shown to the customer for confirmation. Solo handymen always enter the price themselves.
